name: quads
meaning: four border strips of four corners (x, y); written as packed dwords by Ui_BuildFrameQuads (0x53c859), read as s16 by Ui_DrawFrameQuads (0x53d122)

name: uvs
meaning: four strips x four (u, v) pairs, strip stride 0x20 (Ui_DrawFrameQuads 0x53d199)

name: cellSize
meaning: (bitmap width - 1) << 8 | (height - 1): written as one word at 0x53c81c, read as one word at 0x53d0bf

name: texPage
meaning: texture page of the frame bitmap, passed as the page argument to Draw2D_TexRect
